name: Phone width: every page is reachable from the navigation

planSteps.description: Set the browser viewport to 390 x 844 pixels (phone width) and confirm the page is 390 px wide (window.innerWidth = 390)
The navigation links row (data-testid=nav-links) is visible without opening any menu and contains the links EES check, Letter, Parity and Proof
The URL is /ees?scenario=near-limit, the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) is visible, and the EES check link has aria-current='page'
Click the Proof link (data-testid=nav-proof); scroll the links row sideways first if it is not in view
The /proof page shows the rule table (data-testid=proof-table)
